narrative.overview: A tidy workbench for 3D printed objects, with pale pegboard, cool metal-like surfaces, large imagery, and concise labels. Rambla is direct and sturdy; cobalt marks actions and selection. Flat cards rely on image scale, alignment, and tonal separation for hierarchy.
keyCharacteristics: Cobalt for actions and selected states
Square panels and gently rounded controls
Compact product labels and large headings

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Use cobalt for actions and active states; let product imagery supply other strong color.

dos: Do keep product imagery prominent on pale, cool image beds.
Do use cobalt for actionable and selected states with a visible focus outline.
Do identify concept products plainly until real product information is available.
donts: Don't add unsupported material, performance, or purchase claims.
Don't add card shadows or heavy rounded containers to the flat catalog treatment.
Don't promote the home hero's exact composition into a rule for every page.
